input: root is null or an ordinary binary-tree node with readable integer val and explicit left/right links; missing children are null. The finite tree has N nodes with no cycles or shared child nodes, 0 <= N <= 100, and distinct values exactly 1 through N. voyage is an Array containing those N values exactly once. An empty tree and empty voyage are an explicit extension. Python uses None for null and ordinary objects with plain attributes; JavaScript uses null and plain objects with data properties, without accessors or proxies. Integer inputs are primitive safe-integer Numbers, excluding negative zero, NaN, infinities, fractions and BigInt. Arrays are dense ordinary Arrays without holes, subclasses, proxies or accessors; strings are primitive. No concurrent mutation or modified standard built-ins are allowed. Preconditions are not dynamically validated. Size bounds do not guarantee available memory or completion within an unqualified runtime budget.
return: A fresh Array of node values whose virtual left/right swaps give voyage as preorder, using the minimum number of swaps; values are reported in the resulting preorder discovery order. Return [-1] if no such swaps exist. Return [] for a matching tree needing no swaps, including the empty extension.
mutation_aliasing: The complete input tree, every node identity/value/left/right link, external aliases and voyage remain unchanged. Swaps are simulated only by changing private stack push order; this method does not physically rewire children, including on failure. Returned values do not reference nodes. This is an explicit author effect contract, not evidence of frozen predecessor mutation parity. The Solution instance retains no state; separate calls share no mutable result state.
numeric: Unique values make the required next child root unambiguous, so a left child inconsistent with the next voyage value forces the only possible swapped order. Each node is processed at most once; counters and stack/output lengths are at most N <= 100. All comparisons and counters are exact.
complexity: O(N+1) time and O(h+1) traversal-stack space for tree height h, plus O(N+1) worst-case output storage. Failure may allocate a discarded prefix of flip values before returning a fresh singleton sentinel. No recursion, tree copy, serialization or physical pointer-swap work is hidden.
